validated_results.title: Protein intake and cancer: an umbrella review of systematic reviews for the evidence-based guideline of the German Nutrition Society.
validated_results.reason: This publication is an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses rather than an original human study, as stated by "we carried out an umbrella review of SRs on protein intake in relation to risks of different types of cancer.".

validated_results.title: Protein intake and cancer: an umbrella review of systematic reviews for the evidence-based guideline of the German Nutrition Society.
validated_results.reason: The plant protein findings also come from an umbrella review of systematic reviews ("Ten SRs were identified, of which eight included meta-analyses"), not original primary data.

validated_results.title: Nutritional Supplement With Fermented Soy in Men With an Elevated Risk of Prostate Cancer and Negative Prostate Biopsies: General and Oncological Results From the Prospective PRAECAP Trial.
validated_results.reason: This single-arm supplement trial reports PSA, IPSS, and prostate volume changes and compares biopsy positivity between PSA responders and non-responders, so no soy-exposure-specific prostate cancer incidence estimate can be separated.

validated_results.title: Health effects of drinking 100% juice: an umbrella review of systematic reviews with meta-analyses.
validated_results.reason: The article is an "umbrella review of systematic literature reviews with meta-analyses (MAs)" on 100% juice, providing no original primary study data on fiber intake and prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Association between vitamin B2 intake and prostate-specific antigen in American men: 2003-2010 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.
validated_results.reason: The cross-sectional NHANES analysis examines only the "association between vitamin B2 intake and PSA levels" rather than incident prostate cancer.
